one_line: New AI models debut, major industry deals, and policy actions shape the AI landscape.

themes.title: New frontier AI models released
themes.text: Google DeepMind unveiled the Genie 4 world model and Nvidia launched the Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe model, while Google announced Gemini 4 Carbon, which topped AI Index rankings and set new cybersecurity benchmarks.

stories.headline: Google announces Gemini 4 Carbon, a more capable frontier AI model not yet released
Gemini 4 Carbon ranks #1 on AI Index and leads cybersecurity benchmarks
Google DeepMind releases Genie 4 world model in research preview
Nvidia releases Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe and Granary v2 speech dataset

themes.title: Major AI industry investments
themes.text: AMD committed $1 billion to Meta and began installing Helios rack‑scale systems; OpenAI is planning to acquire Google TPUs and expanded its partnership with ServiceNow, and Cognizant is negotiating a $300 million investment in Sarvam AI.

stories.headline: AMD to invest $1 billion in Meta equity offering and install Helios rackscale systems
OpenAI to purchase Google’s AI chips, seeks TPU optimization engineer
OpenAI and ServiceNow expand partnership to embed OpenAI models in ServiceNow workflows
Cognizant in talks to invest up to $300 million in Sarvam AI at $3.5‑4 billion valuation

themes.title: Policy and regulatory moves
themes.text: China released draft export‑control rules covering 23 AI technologies; New York Governor Kathy Hochul signed a law restricting unsafe AI chatbot features for minors; OpenAI set up an election war room to monitor misinformation ahead of the U.S. midterms.

stories.headline: China proposes export controls on 23 AI technologies
New York governor signs law banning unsafe AI chatbot features for minors
OpenAI launches election war room to monitor misinformation ahead of US midterms
